verificationNotes: The WFS distribution is explicitly marked open use in the Swiss catalogue. The corresponding official ArcGIS layer supplies WGS84 coordinates. Gattung and Art are numeric codes. Gattung_beschrieb supplies the genus and Art_beschrieb the German common name. Planting year is preserved; location-accuracy descriptions remain notes.
